controls.Circle: Jump / Let go / Swim fast / Ascend

evidence.Default/Left stick: pdf3 (printed 3): left analog stick: Move character (walks or runs depending on how far the stick is tilted) / Move cursor in menu screen
evidence.Default/Right stick: pdf3 (printed 3): right analog stick: Move cursor in command menu
evidence.Default/L1: pdf3 (printed 3): L1 button: Hold down to display magic shortcut menu
evidence.Default/L1+Triangle: pdf3 (printed 3): Triangle button: Press while holding the L1 button to cast assigned spell
evidence.Default/L1+Square: pdf3 (printed 3): Square button: Press while holding the L1 button to cast assigned spell
evidence.Default/L1+Cross: pdf3 (printed 3): Cross button: Press while holding the L1 button to cast assigned spell
evidence.Default/L2: pdf3 (printed 3): L2 button: Rotate camera counterclockwise (disabled when target lock is engaged) / Cycle through available targets while locked on
evidence.Default/R2: pdf3 (printed 3): R2 button: Rotate camera clockwise (disabled when target lock is engaged) / Cycle through available targets while locked on
evidence.Default/L2+R2: pdf3 (printed 3): L2 button: Press simultaneously with the R2 button to revert the camera to default frontal view
evidence.Default/R1: pdf3 (printed 3): R1 button: Engage or disengage target lock; pdf5 (printed 6): Press the R1 button to lock on to a target
evidence.Default/R3: pdf3 (printed 3): R3 button: Confirm (disabled in menu screen)
evidence.Default/Cross: pdf3 (printed 3): Cross button: Confirm; pdf5 (printed 7): While attacking, press the Cross button at the right time to trigger a combo attack
evidence.Default/Circle: pdf3 (printed 3): Circle button: Cancel / Jump / Let go / Swim fast / Ascend when flying or swimming
evidence.Default/Triangle: pdf3 (printed 3): Triangle button: Command party members to attack a locked target
evidence.Default/Square: pdf3 (printed 3): Square button: Use special abilities / Descend when flying or swimming
evidence.Default/Start: pdf3 (printed 3): START button: Display main menu / Pause (during battle and cut scenes) / Display special menu during mini games
evidence.Default/Select: pdf3 (printed 3): SELECT button: Toggle first-person view on and off
evidence.Gummi Ship Flight/R1: pdf10 (printed 16), Flight Screen, Weapon Sights: Hold down the R1 button to lock the target point
